title: All parts
author: 64cf7168c6edd65797781320
chapter_outcomes: Students will be able to engage in a brief, non-assessed warm-up conversation to build confidence and establish a natural speaking tone.
Students will be able to answer personal and general questions fluently during a structured interview format.
Students will be able to utilize a one-minute preparation period to mentally structure a short talk without the aid of written notes.
Students will be able to deliver a sustained, 3-4 minute continuous short talk based on a provided speaking assessment card.
Students will be able to evaluate multiple options on a given topic and clearly express a well-supported personal opinion during their short talk.
Students will be able to engage in a two-way discussion, responding naturally and comprehensively to an examiner's follow-up questions.
Students will be able to appropriately ask the examiner to clarify a question before attempting to formulate an answer.
Students will be able to regulate their speaking pace and flow to ensure clarity and avoid exhausting their speaking points prematurely.
Students will be able to demonstrate control of pronunciation and intonation while consciously minimizing the use of disruptive filler words.
Students will be able to connect ideas logically using descriptive vocabulary and accurate grammatical structures.
Students will be able to develop their responses thoroughly by providing reasons, justifying opinions, and expressing agreement or disagreement.
